scientific_limitations: The universal theorem concerns only even-order graph-edge inclusions in reduced integral homology degree m-2. No odd-order, lower-degree, equivariant, or full-conjecture conclusions. The cofiber example is finite, with a standalone acyclic Morse checker. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible; independent validation not performed.
title: Split integral next-to-top matching homology under arbitrary even-order edge insertions
